TopicWorkflows.WorkflowContent:
name: 'Login Auth Follow-up'
version: '1.0.0'
description: 'After /api/auth/login, resolve the user and load their API permissions'

# Tokens:
#   {{QuickcodeClients.IdentityModuleApi}}
#   {{GatewayServiceToken.IdentityModule}}
#   {{input.RequestInfo.Body.email}}          # Kafka envelope → login request body
#   {{input.ResponseInfo.StatusCode}}
#   {{variables.retryCount}}
#   {{resolveUser.response.permissionGroupName}}  # previous step JSON fields
#
# Execution: first step runs, transitions jump to sibling step names.
# Terminal actions (no HTTP step): success | end | fail

variables:
  retryCount:
    type: 'int'
    value: '2'
  retryBaseDelayMs:
    type: 'int'
    value: '1000'

steps:
  resolveUser:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.IdentityModuleApi}}/api/identity-module/asp-net-users/get-user/{{input.RequestInfo.Body.email}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.IdentityModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    repeat: '{{variables.retryCount}}'
    transitions:
      - condition: 'resolveUser.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'loadApiPermissions'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'handleUnknownUser'

  loadApiPermissions:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.IdentityModuleApi}}/api/identity-module/api-method-definitions/get-api-permissions/{{resolveUser.response.permissionGroupName}}'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.IdentityModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'loadApiPermissions.statusCode == 200'
        action: 'success'
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'fail'

  handleUnknownUser:
    url: '{{QuickcodeClients.IdentityModuleApi}}/api/identity-module/kafka-events'
    method: 'GET'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GatewayServiceToken.IdentityModule}}'
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    transitions:
      - condition: 'default'
        action: 'end'
